description: Cancel a resting HIP-4 outcome order. Structured mode: apiKey, walletAddress (control), sessionPrivateKey, outcomeId, coin (must belong to outcomeId), orderId (numeric Hyperliquid oid from hl_create_outcome_order or hl_outcome_account openOrders). Partial fills before the cancel stay in the position. Pre-built mode: computedData alone.

accountRef.description: Connected account from gdex_connect. Supplies session key, wallet address, API key and session data so no secret is passed in chat

computedData.description: Pre-built mode ONLY: encrypted payload. Must be sent alone (no structured fields).

walletAddress.description: Structured mode: CONTROL wallet address from sign-in (not the managed address)

name: hl_cancel_outcome_order
